definitions.explanation: Modern slang describing a relaxed, calm, or laid-back atmosphere or feeling. Derived from English "chill" with the Japanese adjective ending い.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧チルい⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: This cafe has a nice chill vibe.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧チルく⟦{過|す}ごしたい→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: I want to spend the weekend chilling at home.
examples.notes: チルく is the adverbial form

examples.japanese: チルい⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聴|き}きながら→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I work while listening to chill music.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY: From English "chill" + Japanese adjective suffix い. Part of the trend of creating Japanese adjectives from English loanwords.

REGISTER: Casual/Slang
Used primarily by young people. A relatively recent addition to youth slang vocabulary (2010s-2020s).

Conjugates as a regular i-adjective:
・チルい (plain)
・チルくない (negative)
・チルかった (past)
・チルく (adverbial form)

USAGE NOTES:
・Often describes music, atmosphere, or spending time relaxing
・Related to the verb ⟦チルする→チルする：29809_chirusuru⟧ (to chill, to relax)
・Associated with lo-fi music, cafe culture, and relaxation

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・チルい⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧ (chill atmosphere)
・チルい⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧ (chill music)
・チルく⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧ (to spend time chilling)

RELATED TERMS:
・⟦チルする→チルする：29809_chirusuru⟧: to chill, to relax (verb)
・⟦{落|お}ち{着|つ}いた→落ち着く：04670_ochitsuku⟧: calm, settled (more standard)
・⟦まったり→まったり：09306_mattari⟧: leisurely, relaxed (established slang)
